build_deit_base_model: build a DeiT base VisionTransformer model with patch_size 16 and 768 embedding dimensions
build_deit_large_model: build a DeiT large VisionTransformer model with patch_size 7 and 1024 embedding dimensions
extract_features_with_VisionTransformer: run the VisionTransformer forward_features method to extract image embeddings from input tensors
extract_attention_with_forward_selfatten: run forward_selfattention on a VisionTransformer to get attention weights from the last block
extract_cls_tokens_with_forward_return_n: run forward_return_n_last_blocks on a VisionTransformer to get CLS tokens from the last N transformer blocks
